---
title: "Lecture 56 — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. Bootstrap resampling of the training set (sample $n$ rows with replacement) for each base model.
2. $f_{\mathrm{ens}}(x)=\frac{1}{B}\sum_{b=1}^{B} f_b(x)$ (or majority vote).
3. At each split, only a random subset of features is eligible.
4. Boosting trains models sequentially to fix remaining errors; bagging trains them independently on bootstrap draws.
5. Variance $\to\rho\sigma^{2}$ — residual dependence limits the gain; lowering $\rho$ still helps.
